summary.text: Elizabeth Fitzgibbon, an independent candidate and self-described mother and advocate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in Wisconsin's 6th Congressional District to Glenn Grothman.
She describes herself as not a career politician and took her own family-law case to the U.S. Supreme Court; she had not held elected office.

paragraphs.text: Fitzgibbon earned a high school diploma from Neenah High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Oshkosh in 2010.
She describes herself as a mother, neighbor and advocate, and her campaign website says her experience taking her own family-law case to the U.S. Supreme Court led her to run.
She ran as an independent, saying on her campaign site that she does not answer to party leadership or corporate donors.
She received 1.6% of the vote to Glenn Grothman's 52.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
